title: Sleepy peacock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail fan behind body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='38' ry='30' fill='#1f7a6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='23' fill='#2fa88f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='21' ry='16' fill='#156b8a'/>
  <!-- eye feathers -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='40' r='6' fill='#2fa88f'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ffcf3d'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='40' r='1.3' fill='#1f7a6b'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='40' r='6' fill='#2fa88f'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ffcf3d'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='40' r='1.3' fill='#1f7a6b'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='82' r='5' fill='#2fa88f'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='82' r='2.5' fill='#ffcf3d'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='82' r='5' fill='#2fa88f'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='82' r='2.5' fill='#ffcf3d'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='14' ry='17' fill='#2b6fd6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#1f55a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='10' fill='#2b6fd6'/>
  <!-- crest -->
  <line x1='50' y1='30' x2='50' y2='22' stroke='#8fd6ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='21' r='2' fill='#ffcf3d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='19' r='2' fill='#ffcf3d'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='21' r='2' fill='#ffcf3d'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes: closed curved lines -->
  <path d='M44 38 q2.5 3 5 0' fill='none' stroke='#a8e0ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M51 38 q2.5 3 5 0' fill='none' stroke='#a8e0ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M50 42 l-4 4 l4 2 z' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='43' r='2' fill='#ff9fb0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='43' r='2' fill='#ff9fb0' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
